units.source_text: 我们走在人群中，人们个个都兴高采烈。

en.t: We walked among the crowd, and everyone was in high spirits.

units.source_text: 穿过人群，走到既没有樱花也没有人群的树林之前，我们一直没有机会谈论这个问题。

en.t: Until we had passed through the crowd and reached the woods where there were neither cherry blossoms nor people, we had no chance to talk about the matter.

units.source_text: “爱情是罪恶吗？”这时我突然问道。

en.t: "Is love a sin?" I suddenly asked then.

units.source_text: “是罪恶，毫无疑问。”先生回答的语气和刚才一样坚定。

en.t: "It is a sin, without question." Sensei answered in the same firm tone as before.

units.source_text: “为什么？”

en.t: "Why?"

units.source_text: “你迟早会理解的。

en.t: "You will understand sooner or later.

units.source_text: 不，不是迟早，应该说你已经理解了，

en.t: No, not sooner or later; I should say you already understand,

units.source_text: 你的心不是老早就在为爱情而跳动了吗？”

en.t: hasn't your heart been beating for love for a long time already?"

units.source_text: 我审视了一下自己的内心，那里却意外地空虚，连想象的目标都没有。

en.t: I examined my own heart, but it was unexpectedly empty, without even an imagined object.

units.source_text: “我心里连这样的对象也没有。

en.t: "I do not even have such an object in my heart.

units.source_text: 我对先生没有隐瞒什么。”

en.t: I have hidden nothing from you, Sensei."

units.source_text: “正因为没有对象你才心动的，

en.t: "It is precisely because you have no object that your heart is stirred,

units.source_text: 你以为有了对象，心就能平静下来，

en.t: you think that if you had one, your heart would settle down,

units.source_text: 所以想活动了。”

en.t: and so you have begun to want to move."

units.source_text: “现在还没到那个程度。”

en.t: "It has not gone that far yet."

units.source_text: “你不是觉得空虚才到我这儿来的吗？”

en.t: "Didn't you come to me because you felt empty?"

units.source_text: “也许是这样，可是这和爱情不同。”

en.t: "Perhaps so, but that is different from love."

units.source_text: “这是上升到爱情的一个阶梯，你是在准备和异性拥抱之前，先跑到同性的我这儿来了。”

en.t: "This is one step on the way up to love; before preparing to embrace the opposite sex, you first came running to me, someone of the same sex."

units.source_text: “我认为这两件事的性质完全不同。”

en.t: "I think the nature of those two things is entirely different."

units.source_text: “不，是一样的。

en.t: "No, they are the same.

units.source_text: 我是个男人，无论如何都不能满足你。

en.t: I am a man, and no matter what, I cannot satisfy you.

units.source_text: 况且又有些特别的原因，更不能使你满足。

en.t: Besides, there are certain special reasons, which make me even less able to satisfy you.

units.source_text: 我实在是过意不去，

en.t: I truly feel sorry about it,

units.source_text: 你早晚会离开我，到别的地方去，这是没有办法的事。

en.t: sooner or later you will leave me and go somewhere else; there is nothing to be done about that.

units.source_text: 我宁愿这样，可是……”

en.t: I would rather have it that way, but..."

units.source_text: 我忽然悲从中来。

en.t: Suddenly, sorrow rose up within me.
